title: Tentacle-shape analysis says the 'jellyfish' are not drifting balloons (compared with Corbell's footage)

tellings.quote: What is interesting about objects of the 7th class, this what we have published images where their tentacles sometimes straight,

plain: Skywatcher, a startup company that says it can summon UFOs, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about objects it calls the "7th class," shaped like jellyfish with dangling tentacles, which it says it filmed at its field site between about 2023 and 2025. The team says its published images show the tentacles sometimes held straight, which they argue means these are not balloons drifting in the wind, and they compare them with jellyfish-like footage released by Jeremy Corbell, a UFO filmmaker. If true, it would mean these objects move under their own control.
